image.altText: An image of the inside of the Printmaking room

text.value: This is our Printmaking Room. Here students can learn traditional printmaking methods like letter press, lino printing, screen printing, block printing and more. This room is popular with Illustration, Fine Art and Graphic Design students but any student from any course can get inducted into this space and use it during open studio time.
To reach the next stop head through the two sliding doors and take the first right into the Printmaking Room.

image.altText: An image of of the entrance to the print bureau

text.value: This is our Print Bureau. Here students can get high-quality, competitively priced prints with a wide range of sizes and a selection of paper types to suit needs of every day projects needs as well as professional finished for exhibitions or project outcomes. Students often get art prints and stickers printed here as well to sell at our Art Markets that happen three times a year. Students can book tables for these markets and sell their own artworks or crafts. It’s a good way to get some extra income, get your name out there and start your business while your here.
Continue through the double doors and down the stairs.
